items.source: whether the pointcut can apply on any method
items.translation: 该切入点是否适用于任何方法。

items.source:
This is an important test as it can be used to optimize
out a pointcut for a class.
items.translation: 这是一个重要的测试，因为它可用于优化针对某个类的切点。

items.source: object - the object to check
items.translation: object - 要检查的对象

items.source: pc - the static or dynamic pointcut to check
items.translation: pc - 要检查的静态或动态切点

items.source: targetClass - the class to test
items.translation: targetClass - 要测试的类

items.source: advisor - the advisor to check
items.translation: advisor - 要检查的顾问

items.source: targetClass - class we're testing
items.translation: targetClass - 我们正在测试的类

items.source: This method goes beyond the implementation of Proxy.isProxyClass(Class) by additionally checking if the given object is an instance of SpringProxy.
items.translation: 此方法在实现 `Proxy.isProxyClass(Class)` 的基础上，进一步检查给定对象是否为 `SpringProxy` 的实例。

items.source: This method goes beyond the implementation of ClassUtils.isCglibProxy(Object) by additionally checking if the given object is an instance of SpringProxy.
items.translation: 此方法在实现ClassUtils.isCglibProxy(Object)的基础上，进一步检查给定对象是否为SpringProxy的实例。

items.source: NOTE: In contrast to ClassUtils.getMostSpecificMethod(Method, Class), this method resolves bridge methods in order to retrieve attributes from the original method definition.
items.translation: 注意：与ClassUtils.getMostSpecificMethod(Method, Class)相反，此方法解析桥接方法，以便从原始方法定义中检索属性。

items.source: See AopProxyUtils for a collection of framework-specific AOP utility methods which depend on internals of Spring's AOP framework implementation.
items.translation: 参见 AopProxyUtils，其中包含一组依赖于 Spring AOP 框架实现内部细节的特定于框架的 AOP 实用方法。

items.source: This method additionally checks if the given object is an instance of SpringProxy.
items.translation: 此方法还会检查给定对象是否为SpringProxy的实例。

items.source: Mainly for internal use within Spring's AOP support.
items.translation: 主要用于 Spring AOP 支持内部使用。

items.source: Returns the target class for an AOP proxy or the plain class otherwise.
items.translation: 返回 AOP 代理的目标类，否则返回普通类。

items.source:
This is an important test as it can be used to optimize out an advisor for a class.
This version also takes into account introductions (for IntroductionAwareMethodMatchers).
items.translation: 这是一个重要的测试，因为它可用于优化掉某个类的 Advisor。此版本还考虑了介绍（针对 IntroductionAwareMethodMatchers）。

items.source: Determine the sublist of the candidateAdvisors list that is applicable to the given class.
items.translation: 确定适用于给定类的candidateAdvisors列表的子列表。

items.source:
Can the given advisor apply at all on the given class?
This is an important test as it can be used to optimize
out an advisor for a class.
items.translation: 给定的 Advisor 是否完全适用于给定的类？这是一个重要的测试，因为它可用于优化并排除不适用于某类的 Advisor。

items.source: Can the given pointcut apply at all on the given class?
items.translation: 给定的切面能否应用于给定的类？

items.source: Invoke the given target via reflection, as part of an AOP method invocation.
items.translation: 通过反射调用给定的目标，作为 AOP 方法调用的部分。

items.source: Determine whether the given method is an "equals" method.
items.translation: 确定给定方法是否为"equals"方法。

items.source: Determine whether the given method is a "finalize" method.
items.translation: 确定给定方法是否为“finalize”方法。

items.source: Determine whether the given method is a "hashCode" method.
items.translation: 确定给定的方法是否为"hashCode"方法。

items.source: Determine whether the given method is a "toString" method.
items.translation: 确定给定方法是否为"toString"方法。

items.source:
Select an invocable method on the target type: either the given method itself
if actually exposed on the target type, or otherwise a corresponding method
on one of the target type's interfaces or on the target type itself.
items.translation: 选择目标类型上的可调用方法：如果该方法实际上在目标类型上暴露，则选择给定的方法本身；否则，选择目标类型的某个接口或目标类型本身上的对应方法。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the given method is not invocable on the given target type (typically due to a proxy mismatch)
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果给定方法无法在给定目标类型上调用（通常是由于代理不匹配导致的）。

items.source: targetClass - the target class for the current invocation (can be null or may not even implement the method)
items.translation: targetClass - 当前调用的目标类（可以为 null，甚至可能未实现该方法）

items.source: Throwable - if thrown by the target method
items.translation: Throwable - 如果由目标方法抛出

items.source: AopInvocationException - in case of a reflection error
items.translation: AopInvocationException - 在发生反射错误时

items.source: the target class (or the plain class of the given object as fallback; never null)
items.translation: 目标类（或给定对象的普通类作为后备；绝不null）

items.source: targetType - the target type to search methods on (typically an AOP proxy)
items.translation: targetType - 要搜索方法的目标类型（通常是 AOP 代理）

items.source: method - the method to be invoked, which may come from an interface
items.translation: method - 要调用的方法，可能来自接口

items.source: the specific target method, or the original method if the targetClass does not implement it
items.translation: 特定目标方法，或者如果 `targetClass` 未实现它，则为原始方法。

items.source: hasIntroductions - whether the advisor chain for this bean includes any introductions
items.translation: hasIntroductions - 此 bean 的顾问链是否包含任何引入

items.source: hasIntroductions - whether the advisor chain for this bean includes any introductions
items.translation: hasIntroductions - 此 Bean 的 Advisor 链是否包含任何引入

items.source: candidateAdvisors - the Advisors to evaluate
items.translation: candidateAdvisors - 要评估的 Advisor

items.source: clazz - the target class
items.translation: clazz - 目标类

items.source: target - the target object
items.translation: target - 目标对象

items.source: args - the arguments for the method
items.translation: args - 该方法的参数

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Sebastien Deleuze
items.translation: Rod Johnson，Juergen Hoeller，Rob Harrop，Sebastien Deleuze

items.source: a corresponding invocable method on the target type
items.translation: 目标类型上对应的可调用方法

items.source:
sublist of Advisors that can apply to an object of the given class
(may be the incoming List as-is)
items.translation: 给定类对象的顾问子列表（可以是传入的原始 List）

items.source: Can the given advisor apply at all on the given class?
items.translation: 给定的 Advisor 能否应用于给定的类？

items.source:
Given a method, which may come from an interface, and a target class used
in the current AOP invocation, find the corresponding target method if there
is one.
items.translation: 给定一个可能来自接口的方法以及当前 AOP 调用中使用的目标类，如果存在对应的方法，则查找该目标方法。

items.source: Determine the target class of the given bean instance which might be an AOP proxy.
items.translation: 确定给定 Bean 实例的目标类，该实例可能是 AOP 代理。

items.source: Check whether the given object is a JDK dynamic proxy or a CGLIB proxy.
items.translation: 检查给定对象是否为 JDK 动态代理或 CGLIB 代理。

items.source: Check whether the given object is a CGLIB proxy.
items.translation: 检查给定对象是否为 CGLIB 代理。

items.source: Check whether the given object is a JDK dynamic proxy.
items.translation: 检查给定对象是否为 JDK 动态代理。

items.source: candidate - the instance to check (might be an AOP proxy)
items.translation: candidate - 要检查的实例（可能是 AOP 代理）

items.translation: method - 要检查的方法

items.translation: method - 要调用的方法

items.translation: 调用结果（如有）
